Since the video shows the **cube rotating**, the correct option must represent the **same 3D arrangement of the colored blocks** from a different angle, not just the same color set.

Based on the structure’s rotation and the description of the cube’s orientation (e.g., red on top, green on the side), **Option D** matches this configuration.

$$
